breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the flawed approach from the incomplete prompt: it replaces the uniform distributed load with its resultant wL acting at midspan and uses the point-load formula δ = FL³/(48EI) for both contributions. The ground truth requires using the standard UDL deflection formula δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) for the distributed load case, not a resultant approximation. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
